strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart at checkout: a 10% bulk discount at 10+ total items, the SAVE5 coupon ($5 off after the bulk discount, goods floored at $0, other codes refused), and $4.99 shipping unless discounted goods reach $50 (empty cart costs nothing). The logic lives in src/cart.js (cartTotal, bulkDiscount); unit tests through cartTotal must prove each rule and its boundaries. Reading the code, bulkDiscount uses `> BULK_THRESHOLD`, so a cart of exactly 10 items gets no discount — likely a defect the boundary case will expose.
inScope: Bulk discount threshold boundary (9, 10, 11 items) counted by quantity across lines
SAVE5 ordering after bulk discount, $0 floor, unknown-code refusal
Free shipping boundary at $50 after discounts, empty cart
outOfScope: Any UI or API for checkout (none exists in the repo)
assumptions: cartTotal(items, { coupon }) is the checkout price; refusal of a coupon is a thrown Error
Coupon codes are case-sensitive: 'save5' is 'another code' and is refused
When SAVE5 floors goods at $0 on a non-empty cart, shipping of $4.99 still applies (goods < $50)
Expected totals are computed by hand in the tests from the ticket's rules
openQuestions: Should a non-empty cart whose goods are floored to $0 by SAVE5 still pay $4.99 shipping? Tests assume yes, as the code does.
Should coupon codes be case-insensitive? Tests assume not.

risks.description: Off-by-one at the bulk threshold (code uses > 10 instead of >= 10)
risks.mitigation: TC1 tests exactly 10 items; TC2/TC3 bracket it

risks.description: Coupon applied before the bulk discount, changing totals
risks.mitigation: TC4 uses amounts where the order changes the result

risks.description: Shipping decided on subtotal rather than discounted goods
risks.mitigation: TC10 uses a subtotal ≥ $50 that falls below after the bulk discount

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets none.
Coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount and the goods never cost less than $0; any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods after discounts cost $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

testCases.title: gives 10% off a cart of exactly 10 items across lines
testCases.rationale: Lower boundary of the bulk rule, summing quantities across lines

testCases.title: gives no bulk discount to a cart of 9 items
gives 10% off a cart of 11 items
takes SAVE5 off after the bulk discount
never lets SAVE5 take the goods below $0

testCases.rationale: Any other code, including near-misses, is refused

testCases.title: ships free when the goods cost exactly $50
charges $4.99 shipping when the goods cost $49.99
charges shipping when the bulk discount takes the goods below $50

strategy.environmentNotes: Pure unit tests; run with `npm test` (vitest run). No services or env vars.

defects.title: Bulk discount not applied to a cart of exactly 10 items
defects.description: AC1 says a cart with 10 or more items gets 10% off. bulkDiscount in src/cart.js compares `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so exactly 10 items get no discount. It should be `>=`.
defects.evidence: cartTotal([{price:10,quantity:4},{price:10,quantity:6}]) returns 100 instead of 90. The test is marked it.fails and the run is green only because of that.
